messages:
marta (SRE): hitting: us-west region showing 60-75% GPU eviction + provisioning lag. Pod churn + OOM throttles from batch jobs.  noticed around 03:05 UTC. can we surface emergency throttles?

oncall-bot: [ALERT] cluster-us-west high_gpu_contention 03:07 UTC - 90% GPU util across p-type pools

raj (infra): yep seeing the same. autoscaler is stuck due to quota backoff on nvidia-pool-1. provisioning requests queued ~240s.

alex (eng-runtime): logs look like kernel preemption on a few nodes, and the new q8-nightly instances aren't coming up because image bake failed in eu artifacts mirror.

marta (SRE): plan proposal: 1) apply tenant-level emergency rate limit for non-SLA tenants (burst 50 rps -> 10 rps), 2) keep Dedicated customers at current, 3) start cross-region shift to us-east for critical routes, 4) post status update. any objections? :warning:

kevin (CS): need a list of which customer ids will get throttled, can we exclude X-corp and Y-enterprise? they have active commits.

raj (infra): we can exclude by tag. current script to set per-customer quota: 

```bash
# ad-hoc limit via admin API
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/quotas -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"customer_id":"<CUST>","limit_rps":10,"reason":"emergency-us-west-2025-11"}'
```

alex (eng-runtime): also add fallback routing for model:route/chat to us-east with weight 0.7 -> 0.3 us-west in the router config. Example snippet: 

```json
{"route":"model:chat","weights":{"us-east":0.7,"us-west":0.3}}
```

marta (SRE): i'll run the per-customer throttle script for the top 30 noisy tenants (by 1h token usage). raj please prepare the script to exempt our SLA tags and dedicated pools. i'll handle routing change after thumbs up.

raj (infra): prepping script now. quick note: applying too low limits will cause queued requests and timeouts at client side; prefer 10-20 rps temporary.

kevin (CS): please exclude premium-dedicated customers and any active enterprise pilot lists. we'll notify them. i'll draft the message for status.redwood.ai and PG.

marta (SRE): drafting status update: "We are applying temporary rate limits for high-volume non-enterprise tenants in us-west to stabilize capacity. Dedicated and enterprise customers are unaffected." will post in ~5m.

sre-incident-bot: runbook step triggered: emergency_rate_limits -> owner: marta (SRE) -> ETA 10m

alex (eng-runtime): also recommend turning off continuous batcher for low-priority queues in us-west to reduce KV cache pressure. small config change: `batcher.enabled=false` for queue-low.

marta (SRE): doing throttles now for batch-traffic heavy tenants. running script: 

```bash
python tools/emergency_throttle.py --region us-west --limit 15 --exclude-tags sla,dedicated --top 30
```

raj (infra): enqueueing cross-region failover job: `reroute-jobs --from us-west --to us-east --percentage 40 --routes model:chat,model:gen`

kevin (CS): copy for customers sent. CS slack alert queued.

marta (SRE): applied per-customer limits to 27 tenants so far. CPU on control-plane increased but stable. will continue.

oncall-bot: [ACTION] emergency throttle script completed for 27 tenants 03:32 UTC

alex (eng-runtime): routing weights updated to us-east 0.65 / us-west 0.35 for chat route.

raj (infra): new nodes starting in us-west but still slow; provisioning backlog down from 240s -> 90s. kube events show fewer evictions.

kevin (CS): first customer reported degraded tail-latency but accepts temporary throttle. thanks team. :thumbsup:

marta (SRE): posting status now. plan to hold for 45m then reassess. if capacity normalizes we'll rollback throttles gradually.

sre-incident-bot: incident timeline updated. severity: high -> mitigated (in-progress).

alex (eng-runtime): small follow-up: capture `redis.kv.cache.misses` and `model.kv.size` for the window to validate impact of batcher disable. i'll add a dashboard panel.

marta (SRE): noted. final: rollback plan = ramp limits from 15 -> 30 -> 60 over 20m increments once node churn subsides. will coordinate with raj and post updates.

kevin (CS): ETA for customer comms follow-up 30m.

marta (SRE): thanks all. closing loop for now, monitoring. :white_check_mark:
